source_policy: Official primary pages only; fresh queries restricted to product domains then directopens; no university domain opened
feature_claim_vs_behavior: All competitor workflow features here are first-party documentation claims; only document content was observed. No logged-in or interactive behavior tested.

sources.title: How To Get Started with College Planning
sources.evidence: Guide describes filtering by location/major/campus and retaining a college list. Public documentation only.
sources.limits: Dynamic college-search directopen returns JavaScript requirement; interactive filters/save/persistence not exercised.

sources.title: Create your UCAS Hub today
sources.evidence: Guide separates exploration/favourites from registering and completing application, offers subject-based exploration.
sources.limits: No Hub account or actual application. UK service scope must not be treated as universal admissions rule.

sources.title: Application guide for first-year students
sources.evidence: Public guide distinguishes gathering materials, support roles and individual testing/writing requirements; exposes requirements grid.
sources.limits: No applicant/recommender account, requirements PDF or individual institution inspected.

sources.title: First-year toolkit
sources.evidence: Public resources grouped by preparing application, writing and working with recommenders.
sources.limits: Resources are design references, not imported admissions facts.

sources.title: MyStudyLife Features

sources.limits: Feature claims not tested; no registration/reminder/sync or outcome verification. Assignment-tracker guide directopen timed out; home/tour are successful authoritative substitutes.

sources.title: MyStudyLife official homepage

sources.limits: Marketing ratings, AI claims and grade improvements not used as proof.
